limitations: Scene is a real game menu, not subtitles, task dialogue or cutscenes. No short-lived subtitle deadline conclusion.
Backend runs were sequential and small; network and OCR revisions differ. Response outcome differences are not caused by a backend on this evidence.
Only successful complete requests are in request duration distributions. Errors and run-end cancellations remain explicit censored outcomes, never zero latency.
WGC recorded five CAPTURE_SOURCE_CLOCK_AHEAD warnings; affected source-frame ages require review. GDI source age starts at acquisition, not compositor presentation.
Dropped counters combine specific application queues/coalescing paths; they are not missing subtitle counts or compositor-internal loss.
OVERLAY_VISIBLE records WPF render callback and filters clipped/hidden/obsolete blocks, not physical screen presentation.
Pre-fix accuracy remains under sampledAccuracyBeforeGeometryFix; post-fix accuracy is separate. Initial game replay ocrQuality actually contained spatial output, corrected by dedicated evaluation.
No complete timed dialogue annotation/display video, no PresentMon and no translator-off game baseline: missed/expired/translation accuracy/game frame time remain null.
Sample counts are small; a single cold sample has identical p50/p95 by definition. No performance target is declared achieved.
Post-fix API completion and effective overlay counts differ: recorded replay completed four requests but rejected all four late results; three later cache hits produced effective overlays.
Post-fix effective overlay age samples include cache hits and correspond to the current block revision, not manually verified first appearance of a whole sentence.
OVERLAY_VISIBLE DurationMilliseconds now measures accepted-translation to WPF render callback; end-to-end source age remains FrameAgeMilliseconds.
Animated background inside the ROI still prevents exact pixel OCR cache hits; no subtitle-priority scheduler or semantic classification was introduced.
Remaining OCR errors include spacing, quotation marks and background interference. No complete frame exact match in the small annotated sample.
Five WGC source-clock-ahead flags also remain in the post-fix run; raw timestamp information is retained and non-negative elapsed values are floored rather than claiming a verified clock cause.
